Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Platform

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build and scale the services that move money for millions of customers. You will own Java/Spring Boot microservices end to end, from design reviews through on-call.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and operate Spring Boot microservices that process card and bank payments with strict latency and correctness requirements.
- Model event-driven workflows on Apache Kafka, including idempotent consumers, retries and dead-letter handling.
- Own PostgreSQL schemas and queries; reason about transactions, isolation levels and locking under concurrent load.
- Run services on Kubernetes (AWS EKS); improve observability with metrics, tracing and alerting.
- Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and drive incident post-mortems.

Requirements
- 5+ years of backend development, 3+ with Java and Spring Boot.
- Production experience with Kafka or a similar message broker.
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL knowledge.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Clear written and verbal communication.

Nice to have
- Payments or fintech domain experience (PCI DSS, ledgers, reconciliation).
- gRPC, Redis, Terraform.
